title: Memorial Stadium (Clemson)
scope: Clemson University’s Memorial Stadium with the joined grandstands, Howard Field, East Hill and scoreboard, and the WestZone club exterior.
limitations: Both exact daytime seating views predate the newest scoreboard. The field footprint and scoreboard dimensions are independently controlled.
Upper deck heights, precise row positions, stair bays and WestZone side elevations are estimates from the mapped shape and photographs.
Scope covers the standing stadium complex. Separate parking and the opposite memorial park are outside the structure envelope.
